headline: Kikit Guide
title: Kikit | Sandball Soccer Boosts Ground Pal Defense | Palworld Guide
video_script: Kikit is a small Ground Pal with a useful partner skill. Sandball Soccer raises the defense of Ground Pals in your party by fifteen to thirty percent, and it does not stack. Kikit also works at Mining level one. You can find it on Sakurajima, mostly around the Southern Sandbar, at roughly level forty six. Build a Ground team and it quietly toughens everyone. Do you use Kikit? Comment below!
description: Palworld 1.0 Kikit guide: Ground Pal, Mining level 1, Sandball Soccer boosts Ground Pal defense, found on Sakurajima.
joke: Kikit plays soccer like the whole team depends on it, and it does.
